independent_countercheck.description: Re-read both closed draft unmerged PRs, their exact successful Netlify build heads, both branch refs, unchanged fixture main and the one corrective commit affecting exactly the allowed file. Compare eight GitHub HTML sources before/after and independently parse all sixteen saved/fresh HTTP bodies. Only the canonical attribute changes; removing the exact owned Netlify toolbar accounts for all served bytes. Native noindex, actual source line endings, alternates, the useful 301 and redirect config remain. Capture the current helper proposal locally against the pinned baseline; its bytes equal the measured commit. A synthetic noindex destination is explicitly refused without accepted pairs or rewriter.
checker_assertions_corrected: The fixture source has LF, not CRLF. An assertion requiring nonzero CRLF was wrong. The source comparison already proved that only the attribute changed; the final assertion compares the actual LF and CRLF counts.

A zero-count issue may omit its optional evidence block. An unconditional dictionary lookup raised KeyError; the final check requires count zero and no remaining evidence, whether omitted or explicitly empty.

A fully refused preparation may omit canonical_pairs. An unconditional dictionary lookup raised KeyError after the explicit refusal was already confirmed; the final check requires refusal, no accepted pairs and no rewriter.

acceptance_inventory.after_snapshot: acceptance-after-completion.json in the live temporary directory

limitations: This cycle completes the one occurrence intentionally excluded from the previous two-file selection. It proves the measured source/destination pair on this static fixture, not every stack, computed/shared template or longer canonical chain.

The existing corrector was already capable of this correction; no production code is changed in this phase. The source's declared master is preserved rather than replaced by an arbitrary self-canonical.
missing-h1 is healthy for the canonical guard but has its own content anomaly. No H1, Open Graph, language, sitemap or other repair is included. Other nonzero SEO counters remain.

Raw previews retain native noindex. Controlled scoring projects only the exact preview host/header into the fixture production namespace using saved XML. This is not proof of production indexing or raw alias/discovery equivalence.
The negative noindex destination and CRLF preservation are synthetic/source tests, not separate live destination-policy builds. The served fixture actually uses LF.
The seventeen families without an exact named record are unchanged. Record references, partial or negative witnesses and family-level mentions do not measure first-client readiness.
No agent deployment, customer site, production capacity, onboarding, scheduler, payment workflow or new PostgreSQL run is included. The 42 SQLite-suite skips remain outside this validation.
next_acceptance_check: Exercise canonical_from_http_to_https and other source/scheme patterns, then the remaining visible families without measured acceptance and the production/customer onboarding workflow.
